title.en: An Act Creating the of City of Zamboanga
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Transfer Free of Charge of All Buildings, Properties and Assets Belonging to the Former Province of Zamboanga and Located Within the City of Zamboanga to the Said City, by Amending Section Fifty of Commonwealth Act Numbered Thirty-Nine, Entitled “An Act Creating the of City of Zamboanga”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3039_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section fifty of Commonwealth Act Numbered Thirty-nine is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 50. Provincial buildings, properties and assets. All buildings, properties and assets belonging to the former Province of Zamboanga and located within the City of Zamboanga are hereby transferred, free of charge, in favor of the said City of Zamboanga."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961
